data_description.api_url: The nanobot voice gateway endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8900
data_description.api_key: API key only required when the gateway is bound to 0.0.0.0 or LAN
data_description.model: Model name to pass to nanobot; leave empty to use the gateway default
data_description.timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for nanobot to connect and start responding. Long tool calls are not cut off by this timeout.
data_description.voice_prompt: Instructions prepended to the first request of each session so spoken replies stay short and free of formatting. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.filler_text: Spoken once when a tool starts before any reply text. Leave empty to disable.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to nanobot. Please check the API URL.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key or nanobot refused authentication.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred while connecting to nanobot.

abort.already_configured: This nanobot API URL is already configured.
